proposed.explanation: DiF < 1.0 does not exist for independent loads; feeder is actually well-sized. Correctly identifies diversity benefit but uses inverse calculation. Assumes simultaneous peaks; ignores real-world diversity. Diversity Factor = Sum of Individual Peaks / System Peak = (18 + 22 + 15) / 45 = 55 / 45 = 1.22. This means the building's three sections never peak simultaneously; when Building A peaks at 18 kW, Buildings B and C are below their individual maximums. The feeder can be sized for 45 kW instead of 55 kW—saving 10 kW in capacity, cost, and Meralco demand charges. This is the primary benefit of diversity factor analysis in multi-building or multi-tenant designs. DiF > 1.0 for independent loads means feeder can be smaller than sum of individual peaks. This reduces costs and Meralco demand surcharges for multi-building services.
